aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in North America at 66.06% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 16.26%, followed by macOS at 8.12%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in North America?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 66.06% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/north-america.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in North America?
faqs.answer: Windows (66.06%), OS X (16.26%), macOS (8.12%) in October 2026.
